title: Athanasius Kircher an Herzog August den Jüngeren: Lateinische Briefe der Jahre 1650-1666 (Editiones Electronicae Guelferbytanae 1)
author: Athanasius Kircher
institution: Herzog August Bibliothek Wolfenbüttel (Thomas Stäcker, ed.)
notes: Transcription of the nineteen Latin letters Athanasius Kircher sent to Duke August the Younger of Brunswick-Wolfenbüttel (Herzog August Bibliothek, BA II 351-365 and others), with line numbers, a transcription with apparatus, a German translation, commentary and source images. Counts are ours, from the single transcription page (about 6,900 words, header lines removed). Published in 2003; the revision log shows the last changes in December 2012 and 2018 (link corrections), so the status is archived. HAB terms allow private scholarly use and bar commercial reuse.
